hypotheses.hypothesis: A bounded dependency delay may expose an unavailable timeout or fallback boundary.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The deterministic business request either preserves its response contract or records a bounded failure.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Capture baseline, apply one fault, observe the business oracle, remove the fault, verify recovery and cleanup.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: The namespace returns healthy and no Chaos Mesh resource remains after removal.
